title: Checkmate at Calvary
style: Early 90s EBM, 128 BPM, pulsing sequenced bass, hard machine drums, noisy synth stabs, numbers-station radio, growled processed male vocal, dark sacred undertone, distant choir stab, cold cyberpunk dancefloor
negativeTags: pop, country, acoustic, happy, ballad, chiptune, synthwave
lyrics:
[Intro]
(Numbers-station voice, distorted) Seven... four... zero... transmission intercepted

[Verse 1]
(Growled)
I whispered in the garden, I twisted every word
I built my towers higher than the cry of any bird
I bought the kings with silver, I filled the night with fear
But every chain I forged for them, He broke when He came near

[Pre-Chorus]
I had the nails, I had the cross
I counted heaven's loss

[Chorus]
(Chant, gang vocals)
Three days, I lost the war
The stone rolled from the door
Whatever I try, He wins
The Lamb has crushed my sins
No dark can hold Him down
I bow before the crown

[Verse 2]
(Growled)
I jammed the radio of prayer with static and with lies
I sold them screens and envy, I darkened their eyes
But one voice cuts the signal like a blade of burning light
And every soul I captured He is calling home tonight

[Pre-Chorus]
I had the grave, I had the key
Now it belongs to Thee

[Chorus]
Three days, I lost the war
The stone rolled from the door
Whatever I try, He wins
The Lamb has crushed my sins
No dark can hold Him down
I bow before the crown

[Bridge]
(Numbers-station voice) Final transmission... the enemy is defeated
(Growled, slower)
Every knee will bend, even mine
Every tongue confess, until the end of time

[Final Chorus]
(Full intensity, choir stab)
Three days, I lost the war
The stone rolled from the door
Whatever I try, He wins
The Lamb has crushed my sins
No dark can hold Him down
I bow before the crown

[Outro]
(Static fades) ...signal lost
